Western tributaries
The Bhagirathi-Hugli is the only branch of
the Ganga having some tributaries. These
are Pagla, Bansloi, Mayurakshi, Ajoy, Khari-
Banka, Damodar, Rupnarayan, Kansai -
Haldi, Rasulpur and Pichhabani. All these
rivers except last two originate from uplands
of Chotanagpur and flows eastwards or
south-eastwards into Bhagirathi.
Since these rivers are exclusively rainfed,
many of them go dry during lean months.
The western plateau is the upper
catchments of all major tributaries to
Bhagirathi and the areas are regionally
covered with lateritic and red soil.
